about_short_description.short_description: Electric Air is a technology enabled contractor that provides electric heating and cooling pumps and their installation services.

product.name: Heat Pump Installation
product.description: Installation of electric heat pump systems that provide both heating and cooling for residential homes, replacing traditional gas furnaces or AC units.

product.name: Ducted Heat Pump Systems
product.description: Heat pump systems designed to work with existing home ductwork, replacing gas furnaces and providing both heating and air conditioning.

product.name: Ductless Mini-Split Heat Pump Systems
product.description: Heat pump systems that provide heating and cooling without the need for ductwork, suitable for homes without existing ducts.

product.name: Heat Pump Water Heaters
product.description: Installation of heat pump water heaters that use electricity to efficiently heat water for residential use.

identifier.value: Online Heat Pump Quote and Home Assessment

product.name: Online Heat Pump Quote and Home Assessment
product.description: A digital service providing quick, tailored heat pump installation cost estimates and home suitability assessments through online forms and virtual site visits.

identifier.value: Heat Pump System Design and Engineering

product.name: Heat Pump System Design and Engineering
product.description: Custom design and engineering of heat pump systems including thermal load calculations, duct sizing, and electrical load assessments for residential homes.
